title: Final Production Audit Before Paper Trading
question: What can still fail in live trading?
executive_summary: Repository evidence identifies 35 catalogued failure modes across MT5 connectivity, ML pipeline, risk gates, execution, restart state, and background services. Three CRITICAL blockers prevent paper trading readiness: (1) LiveRiskTracker.check_entry_allowed NameError on undefined config — risk path crashes on every entry attempt past early gates; (2) paper/dry-run guards apply only to Mt5ExecutionAdapter.execute while KillSwitch, PositionRecoveryService, and Mt5PositionManager still invoke mt5.order_send; (3) USE_ML_KERNEL defaults false so the default loop does not run the audited ML stack without explicit environment configuration.
components_inspected: Decision Orchestrator / Calibration / Trade Quality / Adaptive Risk (factory.build_ml_kernel_stack)
Thread safety (PipelineCache lock, KillSwitch thread, dual managers)
risks: Silent legacy fallback changes strategy and risk profile without halt
Restart loses bar dedup and position manager registry — duplicate actions possible
Kill switch can send real close orders even in default dry-run mode
Pipeline latency timeouts (~11% in Phase24A) trigger fallback under normal load
next_recommendation: Fix CRITICAL blockers in approved phase before any --paper or --execute session. Until then, signal observation only with USE_ML_KERNEL=1 --loop --no-recovery and accept that risk stage will error on entry path (AUD-002).
